info.name: Clio API Documentation Activities Custom Field Sets API
Return the data for all CustomFieldSets

params.name: created_since
params.description: Filter CustomFieldSet records to those having the `created_at` field after a specific time. (Expects an ISO-8601 timestamp).

params.name: displayed
params.description: Filter CustomFieldSet records to those that should be displayed by default.

params.name: fields
params.description: The fields to be returned. See response samples for what fields are available. For more information see the [fields section](#section/Fields).

params.name: ids[]
params.description: Filter CustomFieldSet records to those having the specified unique identifiers.

params.name: limit
params.description: A limit on the number of CustomFieldSet records to be returned. Limit can range between 1 and 200. Default: `200`.

params.name: order
params.description: Orders the CustomFieldSet records by the given field. Default: `id(asc)`.

params.name: page_token
params.description: A token specifying which page to return.

params.name: parent_type
params.description: Filter CustomFieldSet records to those that have the specified `parent_type`.

params.name: query
params.description: Wildcard search for `name` matching a given string.

params.name: updated_since
params.description: Filter CustomFieldSet records to those having the `updated_at` field after a specific time. (Expects an ISO-8601 timestamp).
